verified_claims: Circle USDC Terms last updated October 15, 2026 identify Circle Internet Financial, LLC as the USDC issuer for non-EEA holders; Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS is a dual issuer for EEA holders.

Circle's licenses page lists Circle Internet Financial, LLC as a New York money transmitter and virtual-currency licensee; Circle Internet Trust Company LLC d/b/a Circle New York Trust is a separate NY limited-purpose trust company; First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A. d/b/a Circle National Trust is a separate federally chartered national trust bank.

Circle's October 29 reserve page reports $70.0B USDC circulation and $71.4B reserves. The majority is held in USDXX, a 2a-7 government money-market fund managed by BlackRock, which Circle says can hold cash, short-dated U.S. Treasuries and overnight U.S. Treasury repos; the remainder is cash at large banks.
Circle says USDXX is custodied at BNY and managed by BlackRock. Circle reports weekly reserve/mint/burn disclosure and monthly Big Four assurance.
Circle states USDC is natively issued on 38 supported blockchains, including XRPL.

CFTC Letter 26-05 permits payment stablecoins in 30.7 customer accounts without DCO acceptance, subject to FCM valuation and haircut policies; futures and cleared-swaps accounts require DCO acceptance and the DCO haircut.

CFTC Letter 26-05 permits an FCM to deposit its own payment stablecoins as residual interest in segregated customer accounts, subject to an applicable capital charge. This is proprietary FCM capital, not customer collateral.

RLUSD issuer Standard Custody & Trust Company, LLC is a NY limited-purpose trust company. Its accessible August report lists Treasury bills, government money-market funds and cash deposits; the MMF's underlying holdings need look-through.
Ripple National Trust Bank is approved for RLUSD reserve management, collateral trustee and fiduciary custody roles; Standard Custody remains RLUSD issuer.
BNY supports XRP and RLUSD custody and is primary RLUSD reserve custodian. Standard Chartered RLUSD custody on XRPL is live; LMAX collateral integration remains planned.
Bitnomial's current schedule lists XRP but not USDC or RLUSD.
limitations: CFTC Letter 26-05 does not name USDC or RLUSD and is not a token-specific approval.
No FCM notice of reliance or actual USDC/RLUSD/XRP collateral balance was found.
The CFTC's 30.7 payment-stablecoin path is distinct from futures/cleared-swaps DCO acceptance.
RLUSD government-MMF look-through and an October signed reserve attestation remain unavailable.
Circle National Trust and Ripple National Trust Bank are not the current issuers of USDC and RLUSD respectively.
